quarterly_data.signal: On June 11, 2026 AXT's subsidiary Beijing Tongmei Xtal Technology entered a Long-term Supply Agreement with Nanjing Casela Technologies: Tongmei reserves production capacity and raw-material allocation for, and grants supply priority to, Casela, which commits to buy a fixed aggregate quantity of InP wafer substrates for delivery on a monthly schedule from January 1, 2027 through December 31, 2027 for a total price of RMB 173,000,000 (approximately US $25.4 million). Casela must purchase at least 80% of the committed quantity or pay a cancellation fee, and Tongmei will prioritize Casela's excess demand subject to available capacity.
quarterly_data.figure: RMB 173,000,000 (approximately US $25.4 million) of InP wafer substrates for 2027 delivery; 80% minimum purchase
